description: Land Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1903/16 of 25.02.2015, Rathmalana D/S Division - Cad.Map. No. 521005 and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries modifying ownership details, parcel numbers, and other land-specific particulars for various plots of land in different locations. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, title amendments, and property ownership matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
